headline: BRYSON TILLER'S NEO TRAPSOUL TOUR STARTS
caption:
Bryson Tiller launches The Neo Trapsoul Tour on August 27 in West Valley City, Utah. The 61-date global run features Majid Jordan, Ty Dolla $ign and Austin Millz on select dates before continuing through Europe, Australia and New Zealand.

Source: Sony Music and Live Nation
